visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a pair of hands using a sharp knife to remove the heads of several large, raw shrimp on a black cutting board in a brightly lit kitchen. (2) The hands then peel the shells from the shrimp bodies and use the knife to butterfly the backs and remove the dark veins. (3) The scene shifts to the preparation of aromatics where garlic cloves are crushed using a heavy metal pitcher, followed by the fine dicing of a white onion. (4) In a black skillet, the shrimp heads are fried in oil, with a wooden spatula pressing them down to release orange-hued oils until they appear crispy. (5) Onions, garlic, and shrimp shells are added to the skillet and sautéed before water and rice wine are poured in to create a broth, which is then simmered under a lid. (6) The rich broth is strained into a light blue ceramic pot, where lemongrass, lime leaves, galangal, and tomatoes are added to simmer further. (7) Final ingredients including Tom Yum paste, squid, more shrimp, mushrooms, and clams are added to the boiling pot, seasoned with fish sauce and coconut sugar. (8) A woman with short dark hair in a white blouse appears, holding a red bowl of the finished soup and taking a bite with chopsticks, smiling and nodding in approval.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy acoustic guitar strumming and a female vocal track in the background music establish an upbeat tempo. Rhythmic, sharp 'tock-tock' chopping sounds of a knife hitting a wooden board dominate the foreground. (2) A resonant metallic thud occurs as garlic is crushed, followed by the sound of shrimp heads hitting hot oil with a consistent, bright sizzling noise. (3) Slushing and splashing sounds of liquid being poured into the pan are heard, accompanied by the clinking of a metal lid being placed over the pot. (4) The sizzling transitions into a low, bubbling simmer. (5) Straining sounds of liquid passing through a fine mesh filter are followed by more bubbling and the metallic clinking of cooking tools. (6) A clear female voice enters at the end, expressing positive surprise and pleasure with rising intonation as she tastes the soup.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Prep -> Base Construction -> Flavoring -> Finishing -> Review
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-density, step-by-step instructional cooking tutorial for a Thai Seafood Tom Yum soup. It leverages high-quality visual close-ups and synchronized acoustic feedback of cooking processes to make the complex recipe accessible and appetizing, ending with a personal endorsement of the flavor profile.
